text_block_list.text:
The Japanese Derby has arrived. After
receiving
encouragement from her
mother, Эйсин Флэш
makes for the
racetrack with her usual mindset...
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
But the crowd's impassioned cheering
wakes an
overwhelming desire in her to
win, causing her to
become anxious.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
As the determination to become Derby
champion
fills her being, she takes on
the once-in-a-lifetime
race with great
resolve.
text_block_list.name: Монолог
